reviews.comment: Very easy class. In-person class polls make up a good chunk of your grade, so attendance matters - but you don't have to take notes. Tests are copied & pasted from the book's chapter summaries. 2 exams, no final, 5 HW assignments, group project.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Welch is so nice! This class is the easiest thing ever, I cannot recommend it enough. It is the best possible science credit. All of the test questions come straight from the multiple choice examples in the back of each chapter. There is a group project and polls in class, but you do not have to be present to do the polls. It's an easy A!!

Such an enthusiastic and kind professor! Could not recommend him more for a science credit. I actually learned a lot in this course, and he approached each topic in a really fun and applicable way. Just be sure to attend class because he has participation polls, and look at the end-of-chapter multiple choice for the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Welch is easily one of the smartest and best professor at TAMU. He is so passionate about what he does and the lectures he gives. He does not grade hard, and if you try, you will make an easy A and learn a little bit while youre at it
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Welch was awesome! This class really is not difficult and offers information that everyone should know. I learned so much!

Dr. Welch is seriously the GOAT of professors. He's wicked smart, hilarious, and incredibly engaging. He explains everything with clarity and is always available for his students. Physics for Future Presidents will be the best class you take in college because of him. Exam questions are from the textbook verbatim, so study those & you'll get an A.

Really understanding professor. I once completely forgot to turn in a homework assignment and he contacted me himself asking what was going on and if I needed an extension. He genuinely wants to see everyone do well in this class.
2 exams, no quizzes nor final. 5 homework assignments with a max of 1500 characters. 1 group project to record 5 min presentation, and submit. Daily class polls.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: really funny there is no better option to get a science credit if you're a liberal arts major its all concepts and physics as it relates to non-scientific and non-engineering communities really not that bad as long as you attend lecture and study no complaints

I loved this class. Mr. Welch makes lectures interesting. The tests are straight from the textbook. You need to show up to class to get credit bc there are little quizzes to see if you are paying attention. Need an easy science credit? take this class with him. He doesn't grade hard, he is truly passionate about his teaching & ur understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor - straight forward. If you attend class, you will make an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Welch is by far one of the sweetest and most caring profs I've ever had! He truly cares about his students and what he is teaching them. This course is pretty simple with only 2 exams, in class polls, a couple homework assignments, and a group project. Could not recommend this class and prof more!! Easy life and physical science course!

The tests are all from the book. The questions at the end of the chapters make up the entire test. Honestly, I had so much fun in this class, and learned a lot!! I highly recommend Dr. Welch. He makes an uninteresting topic interesting! If you need an easy science credit or are just looking for something fun to take, take this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great class and prof. Grade consists of two test where answers are straight from the textbook, in-class polls, 5 short-essay hws, and 1 group project. Prof Welch cares a lot about his students and keeps lectures fun and entertaining. If you need a life and physical science class, I highly recommend that you take this class

One of the nicest profs I have ever had! I had several tech issues over the semester and he was always super helpful and gave quick feedback. There were two tests that mainly came from lecture slides and the book and the final grade was a group project. There are daily polls so you need to show up, but you should get an A if you put in the work.

Great professor and class. Cares a lot about his students and wants them to succeed. Graded by two tests where answers come from the textbook questions, in-class polls, a group project, and 5 homework's that are super easy. If you need a science class, I would highly recommend that you sign up for this one
Such a wholesome Prof! Absolutely loved taking this course because of him! He's super passionate, and cares about each student! Definitely recommend taking this prof!

Dr. Welch and this class are great. He is the sweetest guy, super nice, and just happy to teach anything about physics. There are in class poll questions that are super easy for participation grades, and a couple of homework assignments that are no stress at all. Great prof and vibey class!

Professor Welch is such a good prof! If you have the chance to take him then I 10/10 recommend. He is very passionate about what he teaches. Tests are easy because often he emphasizes how important it is to study the questions of the chapter. He had a couple of experiments that he showed which were fun to watch online. Overall, good and fun prof!

only 2 tests and all of the answers are on quizlet. one group project at the end. dont have to read textbook. has usually 3 clicker questions every class but there's wiggle room if you miss a few. super easy and professor cares a ton about students and is very energetic during lectures

One of the greatest professors I've had here yet, he is such a nice guy. The tests are solely questions from the textbook (which he reiterates multiple times before each exam) and grades are based on 2 exams (no final!), clickers, a few homework assignments, and a group project. If you need a science credit DEFINITELY take this class.

One of the best profs Ive ever had! Prof Welch is hilarious and the sweetest guy youll ever meet. If you need a science credit, take this class!! He takes attendance by clickers but it is WORTH IT to go to class just to see him! The tests are long but the questions are straight out of the book!

Great guy! He is energetic and very passionate about physics. He uses clickers but he makes sure you the right answer. Test questions come from the back of the book. One small group project. One of the best profs I have had at TAMU. He acknowledges that we are not physics majors and made class exciting for us!

Dr. Welch is the most amazing professor I have had! He is hilarious, energetic, very passionate about physics and knows how to keep you engaged! His class wasn't difficult at all! Test questions are the multiple choice in textbook with only a couple of question exceptions. You NEED to take his Phys 123 class! You won't regret it- I don't :)

I honestly thought that Physics for Future Presidents was going to be awful. HOWEVER, Professor Welch is the BEST professor on this A&M campus (you can't convince me otherwise). He does a lot of fun experiments in class to make it more exciting. You do have to show up to class in order to get attendance points and tests are very simple.

I loved this class! He uses clickers so you have to go to class because it's 20% of your grade. There are two exams and all the questions come straight from the textbook so you have to buy it but that makes it super easy. He loves what he teaches and is so sweet. Highly recommend!

Welch is such a sweet professor, he loves what he teaches. Class is not mandatory but he does clickers every class which is 20% of your grade. There is a homework assignment every week, they are very easy, I never got lower than 8/10. Exams questions are from the textbook (which you can find on quizlet) give yourself time to study. SO EASY!!

There is no professor i have had at TAMU that enjoys their job more than professor Welch. I have learned a lot of good information I will actually use in my life after this class. Clicker questions are important and getting the textbook helps studying for the two tests. Group project for final.

Take this class!!!! So easy, you literally just go to class, do some clicker questions (Super easy as well) and you can do homework while in there. I use it as my study room and get so much done. Only 2 test and all of the questions come from the book!!! One group project at the end of the semester and you have to present it in front of the class.
This class is an easy A and pretty interesting! Would highly recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: If you need an easy life and physical science credit then definitely take this class! It is such an easy class and Mr. Welch is awesome! You do clicker questions during class, there is weekly homework (but it's so easy), and there are 3 tests but he takes the questions from the test straight off the back of the text book! TAKE THIS CLASS!!

Highly recommend. This class is interesting and an easy A. He is super cool and posts all his materials online. He has iclicker quizzes that are unannounced but if you need a grade boast and show that you are trying he may drop some zeros if you missed class. Tests are the exact questions from the textbook.

If you need an easy science credit, this class is for you. There are only 2 exams, and the questions on them are literally the exact questions from the textbook. Half of the grade is just showing up and doing the easy bi-weekly homework. He's a funny guy, but lectures do get very boring at times - class zones out. An incredibly easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Grade includes 2 tests, attendance, and homework assignments. Homework is SUPER easy, less than one hour a week. Tests are easy A's as long as you do the practice problems from the textbook. Lectures are interesting, usually pretty slow though.
Very flexible office hours. Always responds to emails within the same hour or so.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: take this man. u won't regret it. physics is difficult, don't get behind and make sure you understand the hw and if you don't definitely hit up his office hours. he is very chill and a bit kooky but by far my fav professor at this university yet. i currently have an A test average, it is very doable!!

Dr. Welch is a really nice guy and a great prof! He really wants his students to pass, and if you put in the work he will help you a ton. PHYS 208 is tough, but he is by far the nicest prof. I would take him again if I could! He tries to be funny in lectures so that it's somewhat interesting. Understand the homework on Mastering and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious
